dataset_context.prompt_template:
Premise: {premise}
Select the most plausible {question} of the premise.
dataset_context.notes: COPA labels are zero-based choice indices: 0 maps to choice1/A and 1 maps to choice2/B. The prompt includes both the premise and causal direction.

model_context.notes: Generative models use constrained A/B output; supported scoring models may score both choices directly.
